sources.title: Krea 2 - Krea
sources.snippet: Krea 2 is Krea’s first foundation image model, trained from scratch to give you full control over the look, feel, and creative direction of every image you generate. It ships in three variants — Medium, Large, and Medium Turbo — and supports the most advanced style-transfer system on the market, moodboards, and Generative Sliders. Use Krea 2 when you want expressive, aesthetic results that don’t look like generic AI output: editorial illustration, photorealism with real texture, character work, fashion, worlds, posters, and any project where style and creative direction matter.
